Card Q&A.a: Yes, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If cards that are targets of this effect are revealed from the deck, do I have to add as many cards to my hand as possible?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [D-Reaper] in its traits and 1 [ADR-02 Searcher] among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
